description.zh:
自动快照策略 ID。
- AutoSnapshotPolicyId 和 DiskId 只能指定一个。
description.en:
The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.
- You can specify only one of AutoSnapshotPolicyId and DiskId.

description.zh:
云盘 ID。
- AutoSnapshotPolicyId 和 DiskId 只能指定一个。
description.en:
The cloud disk ID.
- You can specify only one of AutoSnapshotPolicyId and DiskId.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为 100。

默认值：
- 当不设置值或设置的值小于 10 时，默认值为 10。
- 当设置的值大于 100 时，默认值为 100。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:
- If this parameter is not set or is set to a value less than 10, the default value is 10.
- If the value is set to a value greater than 100, the default value is 100.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的`NextToken`参数值。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

description.zh: 自动快照策略所属的地域 ID。您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/api-ecs-2014-05-26-describeregions?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i11) 查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy. You can call [DescribeRegions](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/api-ecs-2014-05-26-describeregions) to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

title.zh: 查询自动快照策略的关联关系

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-auto-snapshot-policy-associations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp12quk7gqhhuu1f0000 --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
